admissionRule: A projection profile is admitted for ingestion only when a RELEASED entry profileSha256 equals the canonical profile sha256, the entry releaseReceiptSha256 and pansphairaHeadCommit match the profile attested provenance edge, and the entry publicClosureEvidence is a 64-hex digest of publicly closed dependency evidence.
nonclaim: XRA-PS-01 (https://github.com/JoFe2/PANSPHAIRA/issues/343) is not publicly closed as of this slice; the exact released PANSPHAIRA projection is not registered. The service fails closed with XRA_KS01_RELEASE_HELD for every ingestion. Registering a RELEASED entry requires controller evidence of public closure and is not performed by this worker.
